BHA maintains Conditional Jockey licensing/training and The Jockey Club directly defines the Jump-racing role; British licence and claim rules stay jurisdiction-specific.
BHA currently maintains distinct Amateur Rider licensing/permit categories, supporting the participant-role identity without universalizing British qualification rules.
JRA directly defines オーナーブリーダー as a breeder or breeding farm with owner status that races horses it bred.
JRA overseas terminology maps exercise rider to 攻馬手 and cross-references work rider; employment and licensing structures remain regional.
The Jockey Club directly defines Work Rider as stable staff riding horses in training on the gallops, while JRA cross-references work rider with exercise rider.
The Jockey Club and BHA directly describe the Clerk of the Scales as weighing riders/equipment before and after races and checking the carried weight.
JRA overseas terminology directly maps farrier to 装蹄師; certification and regulatory requirements remain jurisdiction-specific.
